decisions.rationale: Lead Sneasler+Incineroar: double Fake Out wins the flinch war (their only Fake Out is Sneasler, max 172 < my 189), Intimidate blunts their four physical attackers, and Quick Guard blocks all their priority (Fake Out/Accelerock/Aqua Jet/Sucker Punch). Back Kingambit resists both Mega Froslass's and Basculegion's STABs and OHKOs Froslass even in snow; Mega Delphox at 204 Speed outspeeds their entire team, with Psyshock 4x vs Sneasler and Heat Wave 2x vs Kingambit/Froslass. Blastoise's Water Spout is resisted by 4 of their 6 and Sinistcha is 2x weak to Blizzard, so both sit out.
decisions.notebook: Opponent team: physical-heavy (Sneasler/Lycanroc/Basculegion/Kingambit) with Mega Froslass snow-Blizzard or Mega Scovillain as mega choice; their ONLY Fake Out user is Sneasler (Adamant, <=172 Spe, White Herb+Unburden). My key answers: my Sneasler (189) outspeeds theirs; Close Combat 4x vs their Kingambit. My Kingambit resists Froslass and Basculegion STABs; Kowtow Cleave OHKOs Mega Froslass even under snow Def boost; Sucker Punch endgame. My Mega Delphox hits 204 Spe, outspeeding everything incl. Mega Froslass (<=189); Psyshock 4x vs Sneasler, Heat Wave 2x vs Froslass/Kingambit (snow halves Fire dmg, so Froslass survives one Heat Wave in snow). Quick Guard (Sneasler) blocks their Fake Out, Accelerock, Aqua Jet, Sucker Punch. Dangers to remember: Delphox is 2x weak to Sucker Punch/Accelerock/Aqua Jet/Shadow Ball; my Kingambit is 4x weak to their Close Combats (Sneasler, Lycanroc); their Basculegion Last Respects snowballs as KOs happen, and Scovillain can Rage Powder to enable Blizzard. Plan for series: open Sneasler+Incineroar for Fake Out control + Intimidate, keep Kingambit+Delphox as cleaners; adapt lead if they repeatedly open Rage Powder+Blizzard.

decisions.rationale: Lead Sneasler plus Froslass for Fake Out pressure, an opposing Fake Out immunity, and broad fast coverage. Kingambit covers Sinistcha and Delphox while discouraging Incineroar’s Intimidate and Parting Shot; Basculegion gives the strongest late-game answer to the Fire-types and benefits from fallen allies powering Last Respects.
decisions.notebook: Game-plan baseline: prioritize Mega Froslass for Snow Warning and fast Blizzard pressure. Preserve Sneasler to threaten opposing Kingambit and Blastoise, Kingambit to punish Intimidate/Parting Shot and pressure Sinistcha, and Basculegion for late-game cleanup against Incineroar and Delphox. Scout opposing Sneasler’s Speed relative to Mega Froslass and our Sneasler.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out into their Sneasler is my only way to punish its likely Close Combat/Dire Claw into Incineroar (its CC is a near-OHKO on Incineroar): my +3 Fake Out beats its 0-priority attacks and flinches it, and the only counter is their own faster Unburden Fake Out, which just trades chip. Flare Blitz into Froslass threatens an OHKO (2x, ~OHKO even vs Mega in snow) before it can start a snow-Blizzard loop; Froslass is Ghost-immune to both my Fake Outs, so damage is the only way to remove it, and worst case it Protects or wastes a turn while Blizzard only tickles Incineroar (0.5x, Sitrus behind). Quick Guard is useless here since their Sneasler outspeeds inside the +3 bracket.
decisions.notebook: Opponent team: physical-heavy (Sneasler/Lycanroc/Basculegion/Kingambit) with Mega Froslass snow-Blizzard or Mega Scovillain as mega choice; their only Fake Out user is Sneasler (Adamant). Game 1: they lead Sneasler+Froslass, 2 more unseen. Foe Sneasler: White Herb already consumed by my Intimidate -> Unburden active (280-344 Spe, outspeeds everything I have incl. Mega Delphox), itemless now, neutral Atk; its CC (~182 Adamant Atk) near-OHKOs my Incineroar (2x) and 4x-KOs my Kingambit - never leave either exposed to it. My Sneasler resists both its STABs and holds Focus Sash; Mega Delphox Psyshock is 4x OHKO on it. Froslass: immune to Fake Out; if it Megas, snow's Ice Def boost still leaves it in Flare Blitz/Kowtow Cleave KO range; Kingambit walls it (resists Blizzard + Shadow Ball). Quick Guard cannot beat their faster Fake Out - only use vs their priority once Sneasler is gone (Accelerock/Aqua Jet/Sucker Punch). Plan: preserve my Sneasler sash as their-Sneasler check, kill Froslass via Incineroar/Kingambit, then clean with Mega Delphox (204 Spe) + Kingambit Sucker Punch. Watch: Basculegion Last Respects snowball after KOs; Scovillain Rage Powder could redirect my Froslass kill.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out stops Incineroar from immediately threatening Froslass, while Mega Evolution sets snow and makes Blizzard accurate for spread damage. Our Unburden Sneasler acts before both opposing Fake Out users, so Quick Guard cannot retroactively stop this Fake Out.
decisions.notebook: Prioritize Mega Froslass for Snow Warning and accurate Blizzard pressure. Preserve Sneasler for opposing Kingambit and Blastoise, Kingambit to punish Intimidate or Parting Shot and pressure Sinistcha, and Basculegion for late-game cleanup against Incineroar and Delphox. Our Unburden Sneasler reaches 314 Speed and can Fake Out before opposing Sneasler's revealed 154-189 range.

decisions.rationale: My Sneasler (41%, sash already broken) is guaranteed dead to Blizzard and cannot be saved, so it stays as fodder and fires Close Combat into their Sneasler (~29-59% chip) to drag it toward Kingambit Sucker Punch range (~38-45%) — Poison Jab chip would leave it too healthy. Incineroar is a guaranteed KO to their Sneasler's Close Combat if it stays (77.6-111.4%), so it pivots out: Kingambit can never switch in (CC is a 4x guaranteed OHKO), while Delphox tanks CC (0.5x, ~50-60%) plus Blizzard (0.5x, ~20-29%) and threatens a 4x Psyshock OHKO (239-285%) on their Sneasler. Next turn Kingambit comes in on the fainted Sneasler and Sucker Punch cleans up their chipped Sneasler if it attacks, with Delphox Psyshock as the other kill route; Kingambit then walls Froslass and KOs it with Kowtow Cleave.
decisions.notebook: Opponent team: physical-heavy (Sneasler/Lycanroc/Basculegion/Kingambit) with Mega Froslass snow-Blizzard or Mega Scovillain as mega choice; their only Fake Out user is Sneasler (Adamant, Unburden, White Herb). Confirmed calcs this series: their Sneasler CC = guaranteed KO on my Incineroar from 70% and guaranteed 4x OHKO on Kingambit from full — never expose either to it; Froslass Blizzard KOs my Sneasler from 41%; my Sneasler CC chips their Sneasler ~29-59% (EV-dependent); Kingambit Sucker Punch does ~38-45% to their Sneasler, so chip it below ~45% first; Delphox Psyshock OHKOs their Sneasler at any HP (4x); Delphox survives their Sneasler CC + Froslass Blizzard from full; Incineroar Flare Blitz is only a coin-flip OHKO on Froslass through snow — Kingambit Kowtow Cleave is the reliable Froslass kill, and Kingambit resists both Froslass STABs. Plan: their chipped Sneasler dies to Kingambit Sucker Punch (priority, needs them to attack — they may Protect mind-game) or Delphox Psyshock; once it is gone, my Sneasler's Quick Guard gains value vs Accelerock/Aqua Jet/Sucker Punch. Kill Froslass via Kingambit/Incineroar, clean with Delphox + Kingambit. Watch: Basculegion Last Respects snowball after KOs, Scovillain Rage Powder redirecting my Froslass kill, Lycanroc Accelerock picking off low-HP mons. Mega Delphox timing: Mega when a safe turn appears for the SpA boost; verify Mega Speed with compare_action_order before relying on outspeeding Froslass (non-Mega 171 already beats low-roll Froslass).

decisions.rationale: Kingambit is the safe replacement: it resists everything Froslass-Mega has (Blizzard, Shadow Ball, Thunderbolt), and its Life Orb Sucker Punch (+1 priority) KOs the 20% Sneasler before it can move if it attacks, neutralizing the 4x Close Combat threat — their Sneasler also already burned its only Fake Out. Next turn I can pair Sucker Punch with Delphox Protect to scout the Sneasler Protect/Blizzard mind-game while keeping Delphox (my Heat Wave answer to their Kingambit) alive. Incineroar's one-time Fake Out loses to Protect and afterward leaves Delphox exposed to Sneasler's faster CC.

decisions.rationale: Close Combat is a guaranteed KO on Incineroar from its shown HP and acts first via Unburden. Blizzard is accurate in snow, pressures both foes, and can finish the opposing Sneasler while adding damage if Incineroar switches.

decisions.rationale: Kingambit Sucker Punch is a guaranteed KO on Sneasler from 20% (through -1 Def) with +1 priority that outruns its Close Combat, which would otherwise 4x OHKO Kingambit from full; if Sneasler Protects or switches, nothing is lost. Delphox must Protect: Froslass Shadow Ball is a guaranteed KO at 29% and Blizzard is a borderline KO, and Delphox is my dedicated answer to their backline Kingambit, so it cannot be traded here. I deliberately do NOT Mega this turn: Blaze is active at 29% HP, and Blaze-boosted non-Mega Heat Wave (~249 effective SpA) out-damages Mega Delphox (211 SpA) — Mega's only real gain is 204 Speed to guarantee outspeeding Froslass (189 max), but Kingambit alone controls Froslass (Kowtow Cleave 75-141%, plus Sucker Punch pressure), and I can Mega on any later attack turn if that speed guarantee becomes necessary. Next turn plan: Kowtow Cleave into Froslass while Delphox Protects or fires Blaze Heat Wave depending on their switch-in.
decisions.notebook: Confirmed calcs (Game 1): my LO Kingambit Sucker Punch guaranteed-KOs their Sneasler from >=20% (through -1 Def) and outprioritizes its CC. Kowtow Cleave vs Froslass-Mega through snow = 75-141% (possible OHKO, not guaranteed; chip or double up to secure). Froslass-Mega Shadow Ball guaranteed-KOs my Delphox from <=29%; Blizzard is a borderline KO at ~29%. Non-Mega Blaze Heat Wave vs Froslass = 75-137% (not a guaranteed OHKO). Delphox is max-Speed Timid (171); Mega = 204 Spe, which beats max-Speed Froslass (189), but Mega forfeits Blaze, making Fire moves WEAKER than Blaze-boosted non-Mega (249 vs 211 eff SpA) — only Mega when the guaranteed Froslass outspeed (or Levitate) outweighs Blaze; can Mega+attack same turn. Their Sneasler cannot Fake Out again unless it re-switches; Unburden (280-344 Spe) persists all game — never let it CC Kingambit (4x OHKO) or Incineroar; answer with Sucker Punch or Protect only. Backline threats: Lycanroc-Dusk Tough Claws CC is 4x vs my Kingambit and outspeeds — answer with Incineroar Flare Blitz or Sucker chip; Basculegion barely touches Kingambit (Aqua Jet/Wave Crash/Last Respects all resisted) but Last Respects snowballs after faints vs Delphox/Incineroar; Kingambit mirror stalls (Dark is 0.25x both ways) — Delphox Blaze Heat Wave is the dedicated answer, Incineroar Flare Blitz backup, so keep both alive; Scovillain Overheat is 2x vs my Kingambit and Rage Powder can redirect my Froslass kill. Incineroar still holds Sitrus (not yet triggered).

decisions.rationale: Split guaranteed KO pressure: Sneasler removes Kingambit with Close Combat, while Shadow Ball removes Delphox if it attacks or protects Kingambit. Even if Froslass is KOed first by Sucker Punch or a faster Mega Delphox, eliminating Kingambit leaves a favorable endgame for our two healthy reserves.

decisions.rationale: Bring Basculegion to guarantee priority pressure on Delphox with Aqua Jet while preserving Kingambit for the endgame. Basculegion also applies stronger immediate neutral pressure into opposing Kingambit than our own Kingambit would.

Basculegion Aqua Jet guarantees a KO on Delphox from 29%; Basculegion Wave Crash deals 55.1-94.9% to opposing Kingambit.

decisions.rationale: Delphox is guaranteed dead to any foe attack from 29% (Aqua Jet/Last Respects/Shadow Ball all KO), and switching Incineroar into the Delphox slot risks a guaranteed Wave Crash KO on Incineroar even at -1 (111-161% at neutral) — that switch is unpunishable bait I won't take. Instead, cash in Delphox now: Mega Evolve for 204 Spe (beats max-Speed Froslass 189, removing the speed-range gamble) so Heat Wave fires before Froslass moves; Mega Heat Wave (~63-116%) + Kowtow Cleave (75-141%) is a guaranteed combined KO on their Mega Froslass (min ~138%), and if Heat Wave KOs outright, Kowtow retargets Basculegion for 2x SE chip. This trades my nearly-dead Delphox for their biggest threat and enters a 2v2 with healthy Kingambit + Incineroar (both resist Last Respects) vs chipped Basculegion + their unrevealed 4th, which Incineroar's Flare Blitz covers (Kingambit/Lycanroc). Only bad branches are Froslass Protect or Aqua Jet + low Kowtow roll, both far less costly than losing Incineroar.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Aqua Jet moves before opposing Sucker Punch and guarantees the KO on Delphox unless it successfully chains Protect. Thunderbolt is Froslass's strongest reliable attack into Kingambit, adding substantially more damage than Blizzard while preserving maximum pressure if Froslass survives Sucker Punch.

Sucker Punch's +1 priority hits Basculegion BEFORE it can Wave Crash: my +0 LO Sucker = 73-137% (KOs standard offensive Basculegion spreads, only max-bulk survives), and if it connects Incineroar survives and we get a winning 2v1 vs their Kingambit. Fake Out into their Kingambit (Basculegion is Ghost-immune to it) flinches it, denying Kowtow/Sucker/Swords Dance, so my Kingambit can't be double-targeted to death (their Last Respects ~BP150 + Kowtow would KO my Kingambit from 41%). This line beats Wave-Crash-on-Incineroar whenever Sucker KOs, beats the double-Kingambit line outright via the flinch, and only loses if Basculegion is very bulky AND fires Wave Crash into Incineroar. Kowtow Cleave instead would let Basculegion move first (98-130 > 71), losing Incineroar for nothing and leaving a losing 1v1.
decisions.notebook: Confirmed calcs (Game 1): my LO Kingambit Sucker Punch guaranteed-KOs their Sneasler from >=20% and outprioritizes CC. Kowtow Cleave vs Froslass-Mega through snow = 75-141%. Delphox Heat Wave + Kowtow = guaranteed Froslass KO; Froslass Shadow Ball KOs Delphox from <=29%. Basculegion Wave Crash vs my Incineroar = guaranteed KO from 70% EVEN at -1 Atk; NEVER let Incineroar take one; Basculegion (98-130 Spe) always outspeeds Incineroar (88), so Incineroar needs Fake Out priority for guaranteed value. Aqua Jet vs Incineroar ~25-37% at -1 (survives, Sitrus). My +0 LO Kingambit vs Basculegion: Sucker Punch 73-137% (KOs standard 252Atk/252Spe spreads, fails vs max bulk), Kowtow 87-168%. Incineroar Throat Chop vs Basculegion 46-87%; Flare Blitz vs Kingambit-bulk ~64-75% (2HKO). Foe +1 LO Kowtow vs my Kingambit ~30-39% of max (does NOT KO from 41% alone), but + Basculegion Last Respects (BP scales +50 per fainted ally; ~20-29% with 2 faints) they CAN KO my Kingambit from 41% — never leave it double-targeted without Protect or a flinch. My Kingambit carries Protect; the +1 Atk shown on their Kingambit is THEIRS (Intimidate+Defiant); mine is +0. Their Sneasler: Unburden persists; answer with Sucker Punch/Protect only. Backline threats for later games: Lycanroc-Dusk Tough Claws CC 4x vs Kingambit (answer: Intimidate + Flare Blitz/Sucker); Scovillain Overheat 2x vs Kingambit, Rage Powder redirects. Endgame pattern that works: priority Sucker removes Basculegion before it moves while Fake Out flinches their Kingambit; then 2v1 their Kingambit with Sucker chip + Flare Blitz — their Dark moves are resisted by Incineroar and they can't 2HKO it before dying. Incineroar still holds Sitrus. Delphox is max-Speed Timid (171; Mega 204 beats max Froslass 189); Mega forfeits Blaze — Mega only to outspeed Froslass or for Levitate.

decisions.rationale: Wave Crash moves before Incineroar and guarantees its KO despite the Attack drop. Kowtow Cleave pressures opposing Kingambit, potentially finishing it after Life Orb recoil if it uses Sucker Punch, while avoiding an all-in double target vulnerable to Protect.

Double-target it: my Kowtow Cleave (~20-30% resisted chip) plus Incineroar's Flare Blitz (~64-75%) totals ~84-105%, frequently KOing outright. Even if they Protect, Sucker Punch, or KO my 31% Kingambit with Kowtow, Incineroar resists all their Dark STAB, still holds Sitrus, and guaranteed-2HKOs them while they cannot KO Incineroar through resist+Sitrus before the second Flare Blitz lands. Parting Shot would fail with no benched ally, and Sucker Punch risks failing into Protect/Swords Dance, so Kowtow is the higher-EV chip.

All branches end with their Kingambit fainting to Flare Blitz.

decisions.rationale: Sucker Punch into opposing Kingambit gives the best immediate win chance by potentially KOing it before it attacks; Kingambit can then survive Incineroar's non-critical Flare Blitz and retain a narrow endgame chance.

reflections.summary: Preview plan was sound: Sneasler/Incineroar/Kingambit/Delphox covered everything they brought, and the Kingambit + Incineroar core won the game — Sucker Punch removed their Sneasler and Basculegion, Kowtow Cleave one-shot Mega Froslass from full through snow, and in the 2v1 endgame double-targeting Kowtow + Flare Blitz broke their Kingambit's Protect/Sucker pattern, with a Flare Blitz burn sealing the trade. Delphox as the Mega holder was fine on paper (204 Speed beats Froslass), but the timing gained nothing.

Separately, only Mega Delphox when it flips a same-turn interaction — never into a live Basculegion, whose Aqua Jet priority ignores the 204 Speed.

reflections.summary: The preview plan was sound: Sneasler, Mega Froslass, Kingambit and Basculegion all suited the matchup, and evolving Froslass gave valuable Snow Warning pressure that helped remove Sneasler and weaken Delphox. The game was lost in the endgame because opposing Kingambit immediately removed Basculegion with Sucker Punch while Incineroar’s Fake Out and faster Flare Blitz neutralized allied Kingambit, leaving no remaining answer to their physical core.
reflections.adjustment: Keep Sneasler available after opposing Sneasler is removed rather than exposing it to Kingambit’s Sucker Punch; preserving Close Combat gives a direct Kingambit answer and allows Basculegion to clean only after Sucker Punch is eliminated.
reflections.notebook: Mega Froslass remains the preferred evolution for Snow Warning and spread pressure into this matchup. Opponent may lead Sneasler plus Incineroar and use double Fake Out immediately. They are willing to pivot Delphox into Fighting pressure, Protect it before Mega Evolving, and use Kingambit’s Sucker Punch aggressively into frail targets. Preserve Sneasler as the direct opposing-Kingambit answer; do not expose Basculegion until Kingambit is removed or Sucker Punch is safely bypassed. Allied Kingambit can exploit Incineroar’s Intimidate through Defiant, but opposing Incineroar is faster and its Flare Blitz deals 63.8-92.8%. Basculegion Aqua Jet guarantees Delphox from 29%; at -1 Attack, Wave Crash deals 37.7-64% to opposing Kingambit and 83.2-150.6% to Incineroar. Opposing Kingambit’s Sucker Punch deals 91.8-131.9% to Basculegion and 75.5-111% to Mega Froslass.
